title: Intelligent Interaction Techniques (IIxT) - Proposal
abstract: arXiv:2609.16295v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interaction techniques (IxTs) are the low-level, reusable components out of which user interfaces are designed, including menus, scroll bars, text input fields, and also copy-paste, text-entry, and selecting objects. The IxTs for graphical user interfaces (GUIs) were well established in the 1980s, with relatively minor additions and tweaks for smartphones in the 2000s. Most of today's AI user interfaces involve a chat window, which is an excellent interaction for some tasks, but is generally considered separate from the GUI IxTs. I argue for making the IxTs themselves more intelligent, so users can freely mix modalities, even within the same interaction. This will require research into new IxTs, and also into the infrastructure that will enable these intelligent IxTs (IIxTs) to be built. There are also significant security, privacy and economic implications to this vision.

translated_abstract: 交互技术是构成用户界面设计的底层可复用组件，包括菜单、滚动条、文本输入框，以及复制粘贴、文本输入和对象选择等。图形用户界面（GUI）的交互技术在20世纪80年代就已成熟确立，并在2000年代针对智能手机进行了相对少量的补充和调整。当今大多数AI用户界面都涉及聊天窗口，这对于某些任务来说是极佳的交互方式，但通常被认为与GUI交互技术相互分离。作者主张让交互技术本身变得更加智能，使用户能够自由混合多种模态，甚至在同一次交互中也是如此。这将需要对新型交互技术进行研究，也需要对能够支持构建这些智能交互技术（IIxT）的基础设施进行研究。这一愿景还具有重要的安全、隐私和经济方面的影响。
tldr: 本文提出让交互技术本身实现智能化（IIxT），使用户能够在同一次交互中自由混合多种模态，并指出这需要对新技术及支持基础设施展开研究，同时需考虑安全、隐私和经济层面的重要影响。
en_tdlr: This proposal advocates making interaction techniques themselves intelligent (IIxT) so users can freely mix modalities even within a single interaction, requiring new research on techniques and infrastructure, with significant security, privacy, and economic implications.
